description: FALLBACK ONLY — use request_upload_url + confirm_upload first; call this only after that presigned flow has actually failed. Uploads via base64. Returns { path, filename, mimeType, size } — use path as the File/Image field value in submit_activity. Max 50MB. Blocked: .exe, .bat, .cmd, .dll, .msi.

module.description: Module name. Required — scopes the file to the module's storage folder.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID. Omit if set via env or set_workspace; required in stateless/remote mode.

title: Upload File (Fallback)
